name: cobol-cobc-budget-timing-limits
body: cobc_agreement_and_performance_budget times one cobc batch, which must exit 0, against the best of three release cobolfrontend runs, both over the same scratch tree of cobc-accepted programs, by wall clock on the machine running it; it detects COPY-using programs by a plain COPY word match on non-comment lines. Limits: the ratio can flake on a loaded machine, a COPY word inside a string literal counts as a COPY program, and the exit-0 and accepted-tree paths are unexercised against a cobc-rejected program because cobc accepts the whole NIST corpus. Upgrade by averaging several cobc runs or widening the bound if the budget check flakes, by a token-level COPY check if a string-literal false positive ever appears, and by a rejected-program fixture if the agreement path needs direct evidence.
